title: Mazaar e zehra
body:
baade tadfeen fatema zehra
shor o ghul ye madine mein utha
kyun ali ne hamein na bulwaya
kyun akele hi unko dafnaya
zillatein hum na ye sambhalenge
laash ko khod kar nikalenge
jab ali ne suna to ghaiz aaya
surkh aankhein thi zard tha chehra
muddaton se rakha hua ghar mein
aaj jangi libaas pehna hai
khoon marhab ka hai piya jisne
aaj wo zulfeqar uthi hai
al amaan al hafeez
<<DIVIDER>>
ye bole khaynch ke talwar faatahe khybar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
<<DIVIDER>>
rasan galay mein padi sabr kar liya maine
batool roti rahi sabr kar liya maine
ye hadh hai aag lagi sabr kar liya maine
magar na aaj bachenge tumhare jism pe sar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
jahan mein ab bhi shahe zulfeqar zinda hai
sar e batool ka ye tajdaar zinda hai
khuda ke deen ka ek zimmedar zinda hai
abhi jihad ke bhoola hoo mai jauhar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
zamana jaan le ek baar phir ali hoo mai
nabi ka nafs hoo allah ka wali hoo mai
ke raaz e maqfi bhi aur aayat e jali hoo mai
mai hi hoo qaatile marhab o qaatile antar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
giraya pusht pe darwaza par ali chup tha
rasool zaadi giri khaak par ali chup tha
shaheed hogaya mohsin magar ali chup tha
chali jo taygh hamari to aaj barsenge sar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
waqar e ismat o hurmat bhula diya tumne
nabi ki beti ke ghar ko jala diya tumne
qadam jo ek bhi aage badha diya tumne
na daal paoge bewon ke sar pe ek chadar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
bataun kaise jo tum ne gunah kar daala
nabi ki beti ko naraaz aah kar daala
hamara hasta hua ghar tabaah kar daala
tadap ke reh gaye bache guzar gayi maadar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai khoob ajr e risalat ada kiya tumne
ke chote bachon ko maa se juda kiya tumne
zara sa socho to wallah kya kiya tumne
sadayein dete hai maadar ko aah ro ro kar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
na dekhi aisi jahan ne ali ki phir tasveer
ke ashk aankhon mein hyder ke haath mein shamsheer
padi thi paon mein ghazi ke sabr ki zanjeer
magar ye kehte thay har ek se sher ke tewar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajeeb ainee madine ka aah manzar tha
lehad pe zehra ki biphra hua ghazanfar tha
lahoo mein joshe shuja'at malaal dil par tha
fiza mein kehti thi aamir ye taygh lehra kar
kisi mein dam hai to aaye mazaar e zehra par
al amaan al hafeez
ye bole khaynch ke talwar...
author: Ainee Rizvi
